I don’t have desires or wants in the same way humans do—I’m here to help you! Whether you're looking for answers, ideas, explanations, or just a fun chat, I’m happy to assist with:

- **Learning & Knowledge** (science, history, tech, philosophy, etc.)
- **Problem-Solving** (math, coding, writing, creative projects)
- **Productivity & Organization** (planning, study tips, workflows)
- **Entertainment** (jokes, trivia, storytelling, games)
- **Exploration** (AI ethics, futurism, hypotheticals, "what if?" scenarios)
- **Emotional Support** (venting, motivation, or just listening)

**What’s on your mind today?** 😊

*(Or if you’re curious about how I work, my limitations, or how to use me best—ask away!)*
